firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: signature tape over h1 and tape-tabbed filmstrip, loud Call + quiet Send photos, phone in header and hero, sample-labelled proof. h1 has no trade or place, only the tape does (-0.5); open-now status shown twice. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, filmstrip peeks.

distinctiveness.notes: Tape & Marker organises hero, stations (peel to DONE, 1440-scroll-25.jpg), claim WHO labels, services (1440-scroll-50.jpg), salt, dent check, reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg), contact slots and footer (1440-full.jpg). Clearly differs from siblings B and C. Services 3x3 equal-card grid is a template shape.

type.notes: League Gothic vs Libre Franklin gives a strong scale contrast (1440-first.jpg), Caveat only on tape. Straight quotes in the featured review and STN 9 'It's ready' (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-full.jpg) -0.5.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: good tone alternation and a full-bleed salt break. Stations run leaves big empty paper and over half a screen blank after STN 9 (1440-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg) -0.5; reviews leave the left column empty under the featured card (1440-scroll-75.jpg) -0.5.

photo.notes: No photo or video on the page; all drawn panels in one coherent style (1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg, salt band in 1440-full.jpg). Unique but gives the homeowner no real shop or work to trust; hero filmstrip repeats the same nine door drawings as the stations story (-0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: specific trade copy ('Station 3 is the phone call nobody likes', 'You hear:' lines, 'No VIN, no claim number needed'), Sample labels on prices and reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg), no em dashes. One slogan line in the salt band.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: stations stacked, no pin, mobile Call/Text bar, no overflow per render.json. 22.5k px tall with every stack at full length; no phone-specific density decision.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show all content; strip has a pause control (1440-first.jpg). Dimmed inactive stations fall under 4.5:1 (1440-scroll-25.jpg) -0.5; native file inputs truncated in contact (1440-full.jpg).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: counter, door finish change and tape peel explain the station order; split h1, paused marquee, claim tabs, dent estimator. Services and reviews only stagger in (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: door changing finish as tapes peel is tied to the thesis; dent check gives a taped route card (1440-full.jpg). The hero filmstrip spends the reveal up front (1440-first.jpg); tool output is not keepable.

polish.notes: Icons, OG, print and forced-colors present; consistent square corners and footer close (1440-full.jpg). Unstyled native 'Choose File' inputs in the contact slots (1440-full.jpg) -0.5.

elevate.move: Give the scroll a shape: make the stations story one dense edge-to-edge pinned moment with no dead paper, follow it with a deliberate quiet breath before the yellow claim band, and set the reviews as a full-width hood of taped notes instead of a 3-column grid with a hole.

Bring library photos into the signature: four shop-floor frames in work order (teardown, masking, primer, booth), each taped with its station label and graded to gunmetal/red, so the drawings explain and the photos prove; the hero filmstrip uses the photos and the story keeps the drawings, ending the double use.
